content:
If you missed yesterday's "Surprise and Shine" event and don't want to watch the lengthy full video, Apple's YouTube channel has you covered. Here's a highlights reel of the event.

Apple releases event highlights reel

In addition to the iPhone Duo—Apple's first foldable iPhone—Apple also unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max yesterday, alongside the Apple Watch Series 12, Ultra 4, and the AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation support.

The event ran for approximately 1 hour and 20 minutes, continuing Apple's signature style with executives speaking directly to camera, interspersed with marketing demonstrations and product advertisements.

For those who truly don't have time to watch it all, Apple has also released a lighthearted highlights video featuring a narrator fast-forwarding and rewinding through the entire presentation, summarizing the key points of each announcement segment.

Apple has also uploaded individual full-length presentation videos for each product, all available to watch below.
